task_summary: review the overall organization of the system before planning its future evolution

selected_view.purpose: To understand the allowed-to-use relations and package boundary crossings between the presentation, application, domain, and data persistence layers.

required_information.need: uses edges involved in system architecture, main architectural components, layers, subsystems, and dependencies

What are the main architectural components, layers, and subsystems, and what are their primary responsibilities regarding user-facing functionality, application logic, domain entities, and data persistence?
What are the allowed-to-use relations and package boundary crossings between the presentation, application, domain, and data persistence layers?
What are the core runtime components and connectors, and what communication mechanisms do they use to collaborate for main system functionalities?
What architectural decision records (ADRs) exist that define the current decomposition of layers and subsystems and their dependencies?
What is the system boundary, and which external actors and systems interface directly with the main architectural components?
